title: Fix too sensitive test

author: askhl

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
After these changes the tests pass on the other runner as well.  I'll take the liberty of merging this.

@lan496 I wonder why the test is so sensitive, since there are no uncontrolled random numbers as far as I can tell.

comments.author: lan496
comments.body: I am also wondering the sensitivity of this test. Because the implemented time integrator is high order, the truncation error may tend to hide in the rounding error, which will be highly machine dependent
